name: hot-text
description: Tools/perf/hot-text.mjs and its Jet twin hot-text/run.jet, the generator of Compiler/JetCli/hot-text.list: the functions of a built jet below the first one its runtime pack defines (main left out), traced under fntrace through `jet script.jet`, `jet run`, `jet check` and `jet build` of fresh projects, listed first entry first under a header naming the jet's sha256. The jet is a stand-in static program with a stand-in pack (fixtures/source builds both). Every case takes CC as a stand-in whose tracer runs the program, logs the run and writes a fixed set of the listed addresses with repeats, an unlisted one and a blank line: the gauntlet's launcher traces every process a case starts, so the real fntrace cannot trace under it. Refusals: no --jet, an unknown option, an option without a value, a jet without a runtime pack beside it and a C compiler that fails. The check prints the output with the case directory as <case>, then the list, cc.log and trace.log (or missing).
